additional_software.description: AdditionalSoftware represents information about additional software installed in the cluster.

cluster_type.description:
ClusterType represents the type of the cluster.
The default value depends on the `zonal` value. If it is `false` or not provided, a high availability cluster will be created; otherwise, a basic one.
For high availability multizonal clusters, this field is required.

cni_cilium_settings.description:
CNICiliumSettings
represents settings for Cilium CNI if this CNI was chosen as "cni_type",
otherwise settings will be ignored.

envoy_daemonset.description: EnvoyDaemonset Enables Envoy DaemonSet for Cilium CNI.

hubble_relay.description: HubbleRelay Enables hubble relay for Cilium CNI.

cni_type.description:
CniType CNI type represents type of CNI which will be used in cluster.
Supported CNI types are CALICO and CILIUM. CALICO by default.

enable_autorepair.description:
EnableAutorepair reflects if worker nodes are allowed to be reinstalled automatically
in case of their unavailability or unhealthiness. Enabled by default.

enable_patch_version_auto_upgrade.description:
EnablePatchVersionAutoUpgrade specifies if Kubernetes version of the cluster is allowed to be upgraded
automatically.
Enabled by default for high availability multizonal and high availability clusters and disabled for basic clusters.

kube_version.description:
KubeVersion represents the needed Kubernetes version of the cluster.
It should be in x.y.z format.

kubernetes_options.description:
KubernetesOptions
represents additional k8s options such as pod security policy,
feature gates and etc.

admission_controllers.description: AdmissionControllers represents turned on admission controllers for the cluster.

enabled.description:
Enabled indicates whether kubernetes audit logs should be collected
and pushed into SIEM system (e.g. logstash).
False by default.

secret_name.description:
SecretName contains name of the kubernetes secret in namespace kube-system
with credentials of SIEM system where logs should be pushed.
Fields of the secret: host, port, username (optional), password (optional), ca.crt (optional).
This field is optional. By default, used mks-audit-logs.
Secret name should be as a DNS subdomain name as defined in RFC 1123.
More: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#dns-subdomain-names

enable_pod_security_policy.description:
EnablePodSecurityPolicy indicates if PodSecurityPolicy admission controller
must be turned on/off.

Note 💡
```
EnablePodSecurityPolicy is deprecated as of v1.21, and will be removed in v1.25
```

feature_gates.description: FeatureGates represents turned on feature gates

ca_certs.description:
CACerts represent optional custom CA certs chain in X509 PEM format of provider's SSL certificate.
Will be written to file on masters which will be passed in `--oidc-ca-file` kube-apiserver flag.

client_id.description:
ClientID represents required client id that all tokens must be issued for.
Will be placed in `--oidc-client-id` flag.
It is required when enabled = true.

enabled.description:
Enabled indicates whether OIDC should be turned on in the cluster.
False by default.

groups_claim.description:
GroupsClaim represents optional JWT claim to use as the user's group. By default, `groups`.
Will be placed in `--oidc-groups-claim` flag.

issuer_url.description:
IssuerURL represents URL of the provider that allows the API server to discover public signing keys.
Will be placed in `--oidc-issuer-url` flag.
It is required when enabled = true.

provider_name.description:
ProviderName represents custom user defined name of the provider. It is not used in the cluster directly.
It is required when enabled = true.

username_claim.description:
UsernameClaim represents optional JWT claim to use as the username. By default, `sub`.
Will be placed in `--oidc-username-claim` flag.

oidc.title: OIDC represents parameters to connect client's OIDC provider with kubernetes.

x509_ca_certificates.description:
X509CaCertificates represent custom X509 CA certs which can be used for cluster components.
Certificates should be encoded to base64 format.

Note 💡
```
X509CaCertificates can be disabled for some pools.
```

maintenance_window_start.description:
MaintenanceWindowStart represents UTC time of when the cluster will start its maintenance tasks.
It should be in hh:mm:ss format if provided.

name.description:
Name represent the needed name of the cluster.
It shouldn't contain more than 32 symbols and can contain latin letters
with numbers and hyphens and start with a letter or a number.

network_id.description:
NetworkID contains a reference to the network of the cluster.
It can be set in cases where network is pre-created.

nodegroups.description: Nodegroups contains groups of nodes with their parameters.

affinity_policy.description: AffinityPolicy is an optional parameter to tune nodes affinity.

autoscale_max_nodes.description: AutoscaleMaxNodes represents maximum possible number of worker nodes in the nodegroup.

autoscale_min_nodes.description: AutoscaleMinNodes represents minimum possible number of worker nodes in the nodegroup.

availability_zone.description: AvailabilityZone should contain the valid zone in the selected region of the created cluster.

count.description: Count represents nodes count for this nodegroup.

cpus.description:
CPUs represents CPU count for each node.
It can be omitted only in cases when flavor_id is set.

enable_autoscale.description: EnableAutoscale reflects if the nodegroup is allowed to be scaled automatically.

flavor_id.description:
FlavorID contains reference to a pre-created flavor.
It can be omitted in most cases.

install_nvidia_device_plugin.description: InstallNvidiaDevicePlugin indicates if nvidia device plugin installation was requested.

keypair_name.description: KeypairName contains name of the SSH key that will be added to all nodes.

labels.description:
Labels represents an object containing a set of Kubernetes labels that will be applied
for each node in the group. The keys must be user-defined.

local_volume.description: LocalVolume represents if nodes will use local volume.

preemptible.description: Preeemptible represents if nodes are preemptible.

ram_mb.description:
RAMMB represents RAM count in MB for each node.
It can be omitted only in cases when flavor_id is set.

taints.description: Taints represents a list of nodegroup taints.

items.description:
SwaggerNodegroupTaint represents k8s nodegroup taint that applies for every
node in the group.

effect.description:
Effect for taint.
Can only be one of three types: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule or NoExecute.

user_data.description: UserData represents base64 data which is used to pass a script that worker nodes run on boot.

volume_gb.description:
VolumeGB represents volume size in GB for each node.
It can be omitted only in cases when flavor_id is set and volume is local.

volume_type.description:
VolumeType represents blockstorage volume type for each node.
It can be omitted only in cases when flavor_id is set and volume is local.

private_kube_api.description:
PrivateKubeAPI specifies if kube API should be available from the Internet or not.
False by default.

subnet_id.description:
SubnetID contains a reference to the subnet of the cluster.
It can be set in cases where subnet is pre-created.

zonal.description:
Zonal specifies that only a single zonal master will be created.
It is needed if highly available control-plane is not required.
False by default.
